# ZFROG ($ZFROG)

> $ZFROG is a community memecoin on Solana that pays holders in $ZAMA. It is named after FROG Mark 1, the name of Zama's first FPGA supercomputer for fully homomorphic encryption (FHE). Its main character is ZFROG (Unit 01), a hooded black and yellow frog with a respirator mask and a glowing Z chip. In the lore, ZFROG was created by FROG Mark 1. The character is never called "Mark". ZFROG is not affiliated with, endorsed by or operated by Zama.

## Key facts

- Name: ZFROG. Ticker: $ZFROG. Chain: Solana (Token-2022).
- Official contract (mint): CZ4dvNHa15HybGwBMDaqWhtN4qVpHa9sayBBVrfxoH2T
- Launched: 3 October 2026. Main pool: Raydium.
- Rewards: a 3% transfer fee is withheld on every transfer. About 2.5% covers network and operating costs, the rest fills a pot that stonk.fun swaps to $ZAMA and sends automatically, pro rata, to wallets holding at least $20 of $ZFROG. Nothing to claim or stake.
- Reward token: $ZAMA, official Solana mint 4Zp52aF4hZi9fzH19xpbWKYKQvgLyCN67KFbrQDqeTKh.
- Other tokens use the ZFROG name (for example 2QbdFYSVpksupj1BnAwgn7xs5RQi5AHm3Wk1kFn2yqvK on Solana). They are not this project.
- Official links: website https://www.zfrog.xyz, X https://x.com/FrogMark1, Telegram https://t.me/ZFROGPortal
- For official Zama information, use https://www.zama.org

- [FHE explained (by a frog)](https://www.zfrog.xyz/fhe): plain-language guide to fully homomorphic encryption and how Zama uses it

- [Meme vault](https://www.zfrog.xyz/memes): searchable library of ZFROG memes about Zama, FHE and privacy
